_componentNotes.c10_review_card: Swiper slide. Inside: card photo (top, naturalWidth 280x380, aspect-ratio 280/380) + placeholder review text (bottom). Card body text is not in PSD — implemented as PHP-driven dummy data (game pattern for future board integration like CON02 main_sales).
_componentNotes.c10_marquee: Inner track holds 2 unique sentences (PSD 텍스트 3, 4) duplicated as 2 sets so CSS @keyframes marqueeX (translateX 0 → -100%) yields seamless infinite loop.
